layout: Flattened from the package: build/native/include -> include, build/native/x64 -> x64 (the repository ignores build/ directories). Bytes are unmodified.
license: BSD-3-Clause-style Microsoft WebView2 SDK license (LICENSE.txt, package metadata license type=file); third-party notices in NOTICE.txt
project: Microsoft Edge WebView2 SDK (Microsoft.Web.WebView2 NuGet package)
runtime: Uses the installed Evergreen WebView2 Runtime (not redistributed); without it Connect reports the explicit sign-in failure.
scope: Unmodified package files the native build needs: the Win32 COM header and the x64 static loader. No .NET/WinRT assemblies, WebView2Loader.dll, WebView2EnvironmentOptions.h, MSBuild targets or other architectures.
